name: CRL Parser
description: Inspect a CRL: issuer, validity window, signature algorithm and the revoked certificate serials.

examples.label: Inspect the issuer and the revoked entries

hints.serial: The serial may be **empty** for values longer than 64 bits: upstream carries serials in a 64-bit integer and cannot express longer ones (see the registered upstream gap).
hints.readOnly: This tool only **parses** a CRL; revocation checking needs the issuer certificate.
hints.limit: A CRL may hold up to 10000 revocation entries.

faq.a: The monotonically increasing counter in the CRL Number extension; it tells you whether the list you hold is a newer one.

faq.q: What does an empty "next update" mean?
faq.a: The CRL carries no nextUpdate, so there is no way to tell when it goes stale.
reasonText holds the reason name, for example keyCompromise (the private key was compromised).
